Building sustainable e-commerce solutions that merge tech with environmental impact is my driving force. I’m passionate about crafting digital experiences that prioritize both user needs and planetary health—because innovation shouldn’t come at the cost of our future.  

As a full-stack developer at EcoCart Solutions, I design and implement scalable platforms that empower eco-conscious businesses. My work spans React-based frontend interfaces, Node.js/Python backend systems, and MongoDB-driven architectures. I thrive at the intersection of REST API design and web performance optimization, ensuring seamless interactions while reducing load times.  

Recently, I spearheaded a React checkout system that boosted conversion rates by 22% through intuitive UX refinements. I also optimized backend workflows using Python scripts, cutting processing times by 15% and streamlining inventory management. These projects highlight my ability to turn technical challenges into tangible business value.  

I’m seeking opportunities to innovate in e-commerce tech—ideally with teams that prioritize sustainability as much as scalability. Let’s build tools that move the needle on both growth and green impact.
